understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'; when multiple goals existed, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously to win the level and complete the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement shifted the currently selected piece by one grid cell using directional actions. Pieces could push adjacent pushable blocks, while walls and boundaries generally blocked movement, though their behavior had to be tested. CLICK selected a different piece using its pixel/grid position, and positions were represented in coordinates where each cell corresponded to 3 pixels.
